'''Lana's father''' (Japanese: '''スイレンのパパ''' ''{{tt|Suiren|Lana}}'s father'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|SM}}.

==In animation==
He is the father of {{an|Lana}}, [[Harper and Sarah]]. He was first mentioned by Lana in ''[[SM040|Balloons, Brionne, and Belligerence!]]'', as she recalled him instructing her to stay away from {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Dhelmise}} if she ever came across one. He made his physical debut in a flashback in ''[[SM087|Filling the Light with Darkness!]]'', where he was lying unconscious in his house, due to the effects of a {{an|Necrozma}}, as Harper and Sarah played with him. However, he was not fully seen physically, due to Harper and Sarah covering most of his body, including his head, with a blanket.

Lana's father was fully seen in ''[[SM099|We Know Where You're Going, Eevee!]]'', where he first encountered a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Eevee}} as it was riding on a {{OBP|Mantine|recurring}}. Later, he returned home from his recent [[fishing]] expedition and greeted his family, only to learn Lana recently {{pkmn2|caught}} the same [[Sandy|Eevee]].

In ''[[SM145|Dreams of the Sun and Moon!]]'', Lana revealed that she would be joining her father on his next sea expedition to search for the [[Mythical Pokémon]] {{p|Manaphy}}. He and Lana left in ''[[SM146|Thank You, Alola! The Journey Continues!]]''.

==In the games==
[[File:Lana mother SM.png|250px|thumb|Lana's father in Pokémon Sun and Moon (left)]]
In {{pkmn|Sun and Moon|Pokémon Sun, Moon}}, {{pkmn|Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon|Ultra Sun, and Ultra Moon}}, Lana's father lives in a house in [[Konikoni City]] with his wife and three daughters. He is a fisherman, and his wife states he is good at fishing treasures, such as {{i|Pearl}}s and [[Heart Scale]]s, but does not have any luck when it comes to fishing Pokémon. He personally believes that one can fish up rare treasure if they cast their fishing line over piles of rocks that have bubbles erupting from them.

==Trivia==
* Dub closed captions refer to him as '''Lana's father'''.
